description: This file is a C header (.h) file that declares platform-independent functions and macros related to LDAP Message Element Parser Object, providing declarations for object creation, removal, initialization, and enrollment functions.

methods.name: LdapCreateMepo
methods.description: Function to create a LDAP Message Element Parser Object with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: LdapMepCreate
methods.description: Function to instantiate a LDAP MEP object with specified context and reservation handles.

methods.name: LdapMepRemove
methods.description: Function to remove the LDAP MEP object.

methods.name: LdapMepEnrollObjects
methods.description: Function to enroll required sub-objects or dependencies for LDAP MEP.

methods.name: LdapMepInitialize
methods.description: Function to initialize LDAP MEP object.
